Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/v0.23.1-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ v0.23.1 — new ears for the lyrics, and Space works again

The lyrics engine is new, end to end. It hears far more of what you actually sang, and it stopped writing phrases into the silence — no more online-subtitle guesses. Re-checking a song you already fixed up is three to six times faster now too.

On the computer, Space plays and pauses the song again. Click Mute or a fader first, and it used to press that instead.

Splits open faster and hold much less memory — on the phone as well as the computer.

One more thing: SingZ made it onto the App Store. iPhone doesn't need TestFlight anymore, though the beta is still there for early builds.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/singz-sing-with-the-band/id6806430347

Russian

🎤 SingZ v0.23.1 — новые уши для текста песен, и пробел снова работает

Движок распознавания слов заменён полностью. Он гораздо точнее слышит то, что вы спели на самом деле, и больше не выдумывает фразы в тишине — никаких больше догадок в духе онлайн-субтитров. Повторная проверка уже выверенной песни теперь идёт в три-шесть раз быстрее.

На компьютере пробел снова играет и ставит на паузу. Кликните по Mute или фейдеру — раньше пробел нажимал именно их.

Разделённые песни открываются быстрее и занимают заметно меньше памяти — и на телефоне, и на компьютере.

И ещё: SingZ добрался до App Store. Для iPhone больше не нужен TestFlight, хотя бета всё ещё открыта для ранних сборок.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/singz-sing-with-the-band/id6806430347

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/v0.23.1-poster.png
